function.name: get_dc
function.description: This function is used to get a handle to a device context (HDC). If the HDC does not exist, it creates a compatible device context.
function.return_type: HDC - Handle to the device context

function.name: delete_dc
function.description: This function deletes a device context (DC) if it exists and sets it to NULL. It also manages critical sections to ensure thread safety.
function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return anything

function.name: HFONTItem_Delete
function.description: This function deletes a HFONTItem object. It first deletes the GDI font associated with the item, removes the item from a list, and then frees the memory allocated for the item.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: This is the HFONTItem object that is to be deleted.

function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return anything

function.name: find_hfontitem
function.description: This function traverses the OLEFontImpl_hFontList to find and return the HFONTItem that matches the provided HFONT. If no match is found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: hfont
parameters.description: This is the font handle that the function is trying to find in the OLEFontImpl_hFontList.

function.return_type: HFONTItem pointer. It represents the item in the OLEFontImpl_hFontList that matches the provided HFONT. If no match is found, it returns NULL.

function.name: add_hfontitem
function.description: This function allocates memory for a new HFONTItem, initializes it with the provided HFONT, and adds it to the OLEFontImpl_hFontList. It also manages thread safety with critical sections.

parameters.name: hfont
parameters.description: This is a handle to the font that will be added to the new HFONTItem.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, and S_OK if the operation is successful.

function.name: inc_int_ref
function.description: This function increments the internal and total references of a HFONT item if it exists.

parameters.name: hfont
parameters.description: Handle to the font item whose references are to be incremented.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise returns S_FALSE.

function.name: dec_int_ref
function.description: This function decreases the internal and total references of a HFONT item. If both references reach zero, the item is deleted. The function is thread-safe.

parameters.name: hfont
parameters.description: Handle to the font item whose references are to be decreased

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation was successful, otherwise returns S_FALSE

function.name: inc_ext_ref
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a HFONT item if it exists.

parameters.name: hfont
parameters.description: Handle to the font item whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise S_FALSE.

function.name: dec_ext_ref
function.description: This function decreases the external reference count of a HFONT item. If the total references of the item are greater than or equal to 0 after decrement, it sets the HRESULT to S_OK.

parameters.name: hfont
parameters.description: Handle to the font item whose external reference count is to be decreased.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, S_FALSE otherwise.

function.name: impl_from_IFont
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer for which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: OLEFontImpl pointer, representing the containing record for the given interface pointer.

function.name: impl_from_IDispatch
function.description: This function returns the containing record of the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: OLEFontImpl* which represents the containing record of the given interface.

function.name: impl_from_IPersistStream
function.description: This function returns a pointer to an OLEFontImpl structure that contains the given IPersistStream interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IPersistStream interface

function.return_type: OLEFontImpl* - Pointer to an OLEFontImpl structure that contains the given IPersistStream interface

function.name: impl_from_IConnectionPointContainer
function.description: This function retrieves the containing record for a given interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the connection point container.

function.return_type: OLEFontImpl*, which represents the containing record for the given interface pointer.

function.name: impl_from_IPersistPropertyBag
function.description: This function returns a pointer to an OLEFontImpl structure that contains the IPersistPropertyBag interface passed to it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IPersistPropertyBag interface

function.return_type: OLEFontImpl* - Pointer to an OLEFontImpl structure that contains the IPersistPropertyBag interface

function.name: OleCreateFontIndirect
function.description: This function creates a new font object and initializes it with the specified properties. If the lpFontDesc parameter is NULL, the function creates a default font object.

parameters.name: lpFontDesc
parameters.description: Pointer to a FONTDESC structure that contains the properties of the font to create.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the font object.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObj contains the requested interface pointer to the new font object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. The function returns S_OK on success and an error HRESULT on failure.

function.name: OLEFont_SendNotify
function.description: This function sends notifications about changes in the OLEFont object's properties to all connected sinks. It uses two connection points: one for property notifications and another for font events.

parameters.name: this
parameters.description: Pointer to the OLEFontImpl object whose properties have changed.

parameters.name: dispID
parameters.description: Dispatch ID of the changed property.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: OLEFontImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the requested interface (identified by riid) is supported. If it is, it returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IFont interface.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the interface pointer will be stored if the requested interface is supported.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the requested interface is supported, otherwise returns E_NOINTERFACE.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of an OLEFontImpl object and returns the updated count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IFont interface of the OLEFontImpl object whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the OLEFontImpl object.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_Release
function.description: This function decrements the reference count of the IFont interface object. If the reference count becomes zero, it destroys the font cache or decrements the internal reference of the GDI font. Finally, it destroys the OLEFontImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IFont interface object whose reference count is to be decremented

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the IFont interface object

function.name: font_enum_proc
function.description: This function checks if the character set of a given LOGFONTW structure matches with the original character set stored in an enum_data structure. If it matches, it sets the available character set in the enum_data structure to the original character set and returns 0. If it doesn't match and the available character set is not set (-1), it sets the available character set to the character set of the LOGFONTW structure and returns 1.

parameters.name: elf
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGFONTW structure which defines the attributes of a font.

parameters.name: ntm
parameters.description: Pointer to a TEXTMETRICW structure that contains basic metrics about a font. This parameter is not used in the function.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Specifies the font type. This parameter is not used in the function.

parameters.name: lp
parameters.description: Pointer to an enum_data structure which stores the original and available character sets.

function.return_type: int. Returns 0 if the character set of the LOGFONTW structure matches with the original character set stored in the enum_data structure. Returns 1 otherwise.

function.name: realize_font
function.description: This function is used to realize or create a font object based on the properties of the OLEFontImpl object. It also updates the properties of the OLEFontImpl object to match the realized font.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the OLEFontImpl object that contains the properties for the font to be realized.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: OLEFontImpl_get_Name
function.description: This function retrieves the name of a font object, checks if the name is null, realizes the font, and then assigns the font name to the pname parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the font object

parameters.name: pname
parameters.description: Pointer to a BSTR to receive the font name

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pname is null

function.name: OLEFontImpl_put_Name
function.description: This function updates the name of an OLE Font object and sends a notification about the change. If the new name is null, it returns an error. If memory allocation for the new name fails, it returns an out of memory error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IFont interface of the OLE Font object

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: New name for the OLE Font object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, CTL_E_INVALIDPROPERTYVALUE if the new name is null, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation for the new name fails.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_get_Size
function.description: This function retrieves the size of a font object. It converts the realized font height in pixels to points, descaled by the current scaling ratio and then scaled up by 10000.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the font object

parameters.name: psize
parameters.description: Pointer to a currency type variable where the size of the font will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if psize is NULL

function.name: OLEFontImpl_put_Size
function.description: This function updates the size of the OLEFontImpl object and sends a notification about the change.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IFont interface object.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The new size to be set.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_get_Bold
function.description: This function checks if the font weight is greater than 550 and sets the result to the pbold pointer. If the pbold pointer is null, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IFont interface

parameters.name: pbold
parameters.description: Pointer to a BOOL variable where the result will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pbold is null

function.name: OLEFontImpl_put_Bold
function.description: This function sets the font weight to bold or normal based on the boolean value passed to it and sends a notification about the change.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IFont interface.

parameters.name: bold
parameters.description: Boolean value to set the font weight. If true, the font weight is set to bold, otherwise, it is set to normal.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_get_Italic
function.description: This function retrieves the italic property of a font object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the font object.

parameters.name: pitalic
parameters.description: Pointer to a BOOL to receive the italic property of the font.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_put_Italic
function.description: This function sets the italic property of a font object and sends a notification about the change.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the font object

parameters.name: italic
parameters.description: Boolean value representing whether the font should be italic or not

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if the operation was successful

function.name: OLEFontImpl_get_Underline
function.description: This function retrieves the underline property of a font object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the font object.

parameters.name: punderline
parameters.description: Pointer to a BOOL variable that receives the underline property of the font.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_put_Underline
function.description: This function sets the underline property of a font object and sends a notification about the change.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to a font object

parameters.name: underline
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether the font should be underlined or not

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_get_Strikethrough
function.description: This function retrieves the strikethrough property of a font object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the font object.

parameters.name: pstrikethrough
parameters.description: Pointer to a BOOL variable that receives the strikethrough property of the font object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pstrikethrough is NULL.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_put_Strikethrough
function.description: This function sets the strikethrough property of a font object and sends a notification about the change.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the font object.

parameters.name: strikethrough
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether the font should be strikethrough or not.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK indicates success.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_get_Weight
function.description: This function retrieves the weight of a font object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: An interface pointer to the font object.

parameters.name: pweight
parameters.description: A pointer to a short variable where the weight of the font will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_POINTER if the pweight pointer is null.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_put_Weight
function.description: This function sets the weight of an OLEFontImpl object and sends a notification about the change.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to an OLEFontImpl object

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: The new weight to be set for the OLEFontImpl object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_get_Charset
function.description: This function retrieves the character set of the font object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the font object

parameters.name: pcharset
parameters.description: Pointer to a short to receive the character set of the font object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise

function.name: OLEFontImpl_put_Charset
function.description: This function sets the character set of an OLEFontImpl object and sends a notification about the change.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to an OLEFontImpl object

parameters.name: charset
parameters.description: The character set to be set for the OLEFontImpl object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful

function.name: OLEFontImpl_get_hFont
function.description: This function retrieves the handle to the font object from the OLEFontImpl object and checks if the pointer to the handle is not null. If the pointer is not null, it realizes the font and assigns the handle to the font object to the pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IFont interface object

parameters.name: phfont
parameters.description: Pointer to the handle to the font object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_POINTER if the pointer to the handle is null

function.name: OLEFontImpl_Clone
function.description: This function clones an OLEFontImpl object and handles memory allocation and connection point creation for the new object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IFont interface of the object to be cloned.

parameters.name: ppfont
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer, which will point to the IFont interface of the new cloned object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_POINTER if the ppfont is NULL, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is not enough memory to create the new object.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IsEqual
function.description: This function compares two IFont interfaces and checks if they are equal by comparing their properties.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The first IFont interface to be compared.

parameters.name: pFontOther
parameters.description: The second IFont interface to be compared.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where the return value S_OK represents that the two IFont interfaces are equal, S_FALSE represents they are not equal, and E_POINTER represents that the second IFont interface is NULL.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_SetRatio
function.description: This function sets the ratio for an OLE Font object. It checks for valid input and updates the object's properties accordingly.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IFont interface

parameters.name: cyLogical
parameters.description: The logical height of the font

parameters.name: cyHimetric
parameters.description: The height of the font in HIMETRIC units

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_FAIL if it fails

function.name: OLEFontImpl_QueryTextMetrics
function.description: This function queries the text metrics of a font object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the font object.

parameters.name: ptm
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a TEXTMETRICOLE structure that receives the text metrics.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation was successful.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_AddRefHfont
function.description: This function increases the external reference count for a font object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the font object

parameters.name: hfont
parameters.description: Handle to the font object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_INVALIDARG if hfont is null, otherwise returns the result of inc_ext_ref function

function.name: OLEFontImpl_ReleaseHfont
function.description: This function releases a font handle from an OLEFontImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to an OLEFontImpl object.

parameters.name: hfont
parameters.description: Handle to a font object to be released.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_INVALIDARG if the hfont is NULL, otherwise returns the result of dec_ext_ref(hfont).

function.name: OLEFontImpl_SetHdc
function.description: This function is a stub, intended to be implemented in the future. Currently, it returns E_NOTIMPL to indicate that it is not implemented.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to an OLEFontImpl object

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to a device context

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Currently, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IDispatch_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries the interface of an OLE Font Implementation object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the object

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppvoid
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function call

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IDispatch_Release
function.description: This function releases the IDispatch interface of the OLEFontImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDispatch interface of the OLEFontImpl object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the OLEFontImpl object after the IDispatch interface has been released.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IDispatch_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count for an interface on an object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface on an object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_GetTypeInfoCount
function.description: This function retrieves the number of type information interfaces that an object provides (either 0 or 1).

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that the client is to use to communicate with the object.

parameters.name: pctinfo
parameters.description: Pointer to a location that receives the number of type information interfaces provided by the object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_GetTypeInfo
function.description: This function retrieves the type information for an object, which can be used to get the type information for an interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that the client is to use to communicate with the object

parameters.name: iTInfo
parameters.description: Specifies the type information to return

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: The locale identifier for the type information

parameters.name: ppTInfo
parameters.description: Pointer to the requested type information object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns the result of loading the type library and getting the type information of the specified GUID.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_GetIDsOfNames
function.description: This function retrieves the IDs of the names of the OLE font implementation. It checks if the number of names is zero, gets the type information of the interface, and converts the names to DISPIDs.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the OLE font implementation

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface

parameters.name: rgszNames
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of names to be converted to DISPIDs

parameters.name: cNames
parameters.description: Count of the names to be converted

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier

parameters.name: rgDispId
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of DISPIDs

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_Invoke
function.description: This function is used to invoke a method or property through IDispatch interface in OLEFontImpl. It validates parameters and handles different dispatch identifiers for font properties.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface.

parameters.name: dispIdMember
parameters.description: Identifier of the member.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier.

parameters.name: wFlags
parameters.description: Flags describing the context of the method call.

parameters.name: pDispParams
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure containing an array of arguments.

parameters.name: pVarResult
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the result is to be stored.

parameters.name: pExepInfo
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that contains exception information.

parameters.name: puArgErr
parameters.description: The index within rgvarg of the first argument that has an error.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It can return various error codes based on the condition.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IPersistStream_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface of a persistent stream object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a persistent stream object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvoid
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. It can indicate success or failure, and carries information about the result of the function.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IPersistStream_Release
function.description: This function releases the IPersistStream interface of the OLEFontImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IPersistStream interface that is to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the OLEFontImpl object after the interface has been released.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IPersistStream_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to an OLEFontImpl object via its IPersistStream interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IPersistStream interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the OLEFontImpl object.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_GetClassID
function.description: This function checks if the pClassID pointer is null, if not, it assigns the value of CLSID_StdFont to the memory location pointed by pClassID.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer used in the function

parameters.name: pClassID
parameters.description: Pointer to a CLSID variable. If this pointer is not null, the function assigns the value of CLSID_StdFont to the memory location it points to.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pClassID is null.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IsDirty
function.description: This function checks if an OLE Font object is dirty, i.e., if it has been modified since it was last saved.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to an OLE Font object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_Load
function.description: This function loads a font from a stream, reads its attributes and sets them to the OLEFontImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the persistent stream from which the font is loaded

parameters.name: pLoadStream
parameters.description: Stream from which the font data is read

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation was successful, E_FAIL otherwise

function.name: OLEFontImpl_Save
function.description: This function saves the font attributes to a stream. It writes the version, charset, attributes, weight, size, and font name to the stream. If any write operation fails, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the persist stream.

parameters.name: pOutStream
parameters.description: Output stream where the font attributes are to be written.

parameters.name: fClearDirty
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to clear the 'dirty' state of the object after saving.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, E_FAIL if a write operation failed, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation failed.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_GetSizeMax
function.description: This function calculates the maximum size of the OLEFontImpl object and stores it in the pcbSize parameter. It also checks if the pcbSize parameter is NULL, and if so, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the OLEFontImpl object.

parameters.name: pcbSize
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the size of the stream needed to save the object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pcbSize is NULL.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IConnectionPointContainer_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface from the IConnectionPointContainer interface of the OLEFontImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IConnectionPointContainer interface.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvoid
parameters.description: Address of the pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. The value S_OK indicates success and other values indicate failure.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IConnectionPointContainer_Release
function.description: This function releases the IConnectionPointContainer interface and returns the status of the operation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IConnectionPointContainer interface that is to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the operation after releasing the IConnectionPointContainer interface.

function.name: OLEFontImpl_IConnectionPointContainer_AddRef
function.description: This function is used to increment the reference count of an OLEFontImpl object

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IConnectionPointContainer interface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the OLEFontImpl object

function.name: OLEFontImpl_EnumConnectionPoints
function.description: This function is a stub and not yet implemented. It is supposed to enumerate connection points of an OLE font implementation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the connection point container

parameters.name: ppEnum
parameters.description: Pointer to the enumeration of connection points
